results.releaseNotes:
Your Apple Watch collects a lot of health data. Body Insights turns it into plain advice you can use.

Most health apps show numbers. Body Insights explains what those numbers may mean for your day. It reads sleep, heart rate, HRV, temperature, stress, workouts, recovery, cycle context, and energy. Then it gives you a simple daily picture: push, take it easy, or recover.

You do not need a new wearable. If you already use Apple Watch and Apple Health, Body Insights helps you understand the data you already have. The Apple Watch experience gives you quick reads from your wrist, with clearer states when data has not synced yet.

FOR WOMEN

Body Insights can personalize sleep, exercise guidance, and Symptom Radar around cycle context. Temperature changes can mean different things at different points in the cycle. Body Insights uses that context before treating a change as unusual.

QUESTIONS BODY INSIGHTS HELPS ANSWER

Can I push today?
Body Insights looks at recovery, sleep, stress, heart rate, cycle context, and recent activity. It helps you choose a harder day or a lighter day.

Why do I feel tired?
Body Insights checks Body Battery, sleep debt, stress load, HRV, and recovery trends so you can see what may be draining you.

Are my body signals changing?
Symptom Radar watches temperature, HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, recovery, and cycle context. It does not diagnose anything. It helps you notice when your body is acting differently than usual.

FEATURES

- Apple Watch: quick health and recovery signals from your wrist
- Body Battery: a simple estimate of usable energy today
- Waking Recovery: a clear read on whether your body is ready for more
- Sleep Score and Sleep Debt: see sleep quality and missed sleep
- HRV and RMSSD: plain-language stress and recovery signals
- Training Load: see whether recent workouts match recovery
- Resilience Score: understand how much strain your body may handle today
- Symptom Radar: watch temperature, HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, recovery, and cycle context
- Burnout Manager: see when stress and low recovery are stacking up
- Fitness Age: understand your fitness level in a simple way
- Glucose Insights: connect compatible CGM data with sleep, stress, workouts, and recovery

WHO BODY INSIGHTS IS FOR

Body Insights is for people who want to understand their body without reading charts all day. It is useful if you train, recover slowly, travel often, manage stress, or want guidance that can account for women's cycle context.
results.description:
Body Insights is chronic illness management for people who crash.
It is a symptom tracker for pacing with ME/CFS, long COVID, POTS or fatigue.
See your energy budget on a bad day or a flare, and get a hint to rest.

PACE A CHRONIC ILLNESS (Premium)
Body Insights reads and interprets Apple Health data so you can plan each day around the energy you have.
• Not sure how much to do today? Coach gives daily guidance that respects your limits.
• Wake up drained? Your daily state shows what kind of day this is before you make plans.
• Too tired to open the app? Log a check-in in seconds from iPhone or Apple Watch. Record a day score, symptom tags, and a note. Tags include fatigue, brain fog, aches, unrefreshing sleep, dizzy on standing, headache, heart racing and more, plus custom tags.
• Running low by midday? Your energy budget shows the energy you can expect today, what you have spent, and what is left.
• Bad days seem random? Patterns show what tends to follow your busier days, so you can plan rest.
• Symptoms scattered across notes? Common check-in symptoms, such as fatigue, headache and dizziness, are saved to Apple Health.
• Appointment coming up? Share a doctor report: a PDF of your last 30 or 90 days.
• Your personal step ceiling adds one more signal to your daily guidance.

WHEN YOUR SIGNALS SHIFT (Premium)
Body Insights compares you to your own baseline, not to an average person.
• Symptom Radar alerts you when your signals move away from your usual levels, a hint to rest.

UNDERSTAND EVERY DAY (Free)
Body Insights turns Apple Watch data into plain daily scores for people who want to understand their body.
• Body Battery: see your energy across the day. The energy forecast, circadian view and alerts are Premium.
• Sleep score: understand how last night went.
• Daily stress: see your stress load. Resilience and Burnout views are Premium.
• Morning Report: a short summary to start your day, free 3 per week, unlimited with Premium.
• Fitness Age: your cardio fitness shown as an age.
• Biological Age: add your lab results to see an age profile from your blood work.
• Home Screen widgets for Body Battery and stress.

WANT MORE DETAIL? (Premium)
Body Insights shows how your heart, nervous system and sleep compare to your age.
• Heart Age, Nervous System Age, Sleep Age and Pace of Aging.
• CGM glucose next to your sleep and workouts, read from Apple Health.
• DNA Analysis: add a raw DNA file for supplement, nutrition and medication gene insights.
• On Apple Watch, start a heart rate alert session. You get a tap on the wrist when your heart rate crosses limits you set.
• Training load to balance training and rest.
• More Home Screen widgets, such as Resilience and Coach.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: Body Battery, sleep score, daily stress, Fitness Age, Biological Age, Body Battery and stress widgets and 3 Morning Reports per week.
Premium adds: the chronic illness module, Symptom Radar, Coach, doctor report, Heart, Nervous System and Sleep Age, CGM glucose, DNA Analysis, training load, the Apple Watch app, more widgets and unlimited Morning Reports.

Not medical advice.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

results.description:
Know each morning whether to push or take it easy. Ready turns your Apple Watch HRV, resting heart rate and sleep into one readiness score: green, yellow or red.

Ready is built for runners, cyclists, and everyday endurance athletes who sleep in their Apple Watch and want a useful answer from their health data.

Each morning, Ready combines your HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, and respiratory rate into one readiness score. Tag what shaped the previous night, such as a late meal, hard training, high stress, travel, alcohol, or feeling unwell. After enough tagged and clean mornings, Ready shows patterns from your own history and suggests one practical move for today.

YOUR MORNING LOOP

- Check one readiness score
- Tag what shaped last night
- Compare tagged mornings with clean mornings
- Act on one personal pattern

BUILT AROUND APPLE WATCH

- HealthKit integration
- Context check-in on iPhone and Apple Watch
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Morning reminders when it is time to check and tag

HONEST BY DESIGN

Ready requires at least three tagged and three clean mornings before showing a pattern. Results are associations from your history, not proof that a habit caused a score change. Readiness is a fitness signal, not medical advice.

Your health data is processed on your devices. Optional, privacy-safe product analytics can be disabled in Settings and never include your tag identity or readiness values.

Requires an iPhone with Apple Health data. Apple Watch and overnight wear are recommended for the complete experience.

READY PRO

Your daily readiness score remains free after the 14-day full-access period. Ready offers optional monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions and a lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.alma-innovations.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.alma-innovations.com/terms

results.releaseNotes:
A new look.

Today, the score detail, History and the paywall are redesigned: one clean background, bigger numbers, and a thin arc for each part of your score. The daily briefing, the weekly report, the forecast and your training load follow the same design.

The score detail is now open to everyone. Tap Recovery, Sleep, Stress or Activity to see what went into it.

The recovery alert is easier to read, and its advice names the signal that triggered it.

The weekly trend no longer calls a rise or a dip from too few days of data.

Profile and Coach use the same type and icons as the rest of the app.
results.description:
Readiness helps athletes and fitness enthusiasts train smarter by tracking daily recovery from Heart Rate Variability (HRV), resting heart rate, sleep, and activity in Apple Health.

KNOW WHEN TO PUSH. KNOW WHEN TO REST. Every morning, Readiness calculates your recovery score and tells you how ready your body is to train. Stop guessing. Stop overtraining. Start listening to your body.

WHAT READINESS TRACKS • HRV, the strongest recovery signal available • Resting heart rate, a key indicator of nervous system stress • Sleep duration, stages, and efficiency • Steps and daily activity • Training load from your workouts

WORKS WITH THE GEAR YOU ALREADY OWN Readiness reads from Apple Health, so it works with virtually any device that writes there: Apple Watch, Garmin, Polar, Fitbit, Whoop, Samsung Galaxy Watch, Oura Ring and more. One coach for all your data, whatever you wear. If your watch does not share HRV with Apple Health, you can enter it yourself in a couple of taps.

YOUR DAILY BRIEFING A personalised morning summary written by an AI coach that knows your numbers. It explains why your score is what it is, and whether today calls for a hard session or active recovery.

ASK YOUR COACH ANYTHING "Should I do my long run tomorrow?" "Why is my HRV low on Thursdays?" Your coach has your full history and answers in plain English rather than charts.

SEE THREE DAYS AHEAD A readiness forecast for the days ahead, so you can move your key session before fatigue arrives instead of after.

CATCH OVERTRAINING EARLY Readiness watches for the patterns that precede burnout and tells you before you dig a hole you have to climb out of.

TAG WHAT AFFECTS YOU Log alcohol, illness, travel, stress, or a late night, and watch your coach connect them to what your body did next.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN A widget keeps today's score one glance away, so you know before you go.

ALSO INCLUDED • Weekly report on your trends and training load • Cycle-aware scores: with cycle tracking on, period dates are read from Apple Health and, after two cycles, your HRV and resting heart rate are compared with the same phase of your earlier cycles • Streaks to keep you consistent • CSV export of your own data • Family Sharing on Pro subscriptions

YOUR PRIVACY Your readiness score is calculated on your device. The AI features send the relevant metrics to Anthropic's Claude to write your briefing and chat replies, and nothing more. Your data is never sold and never shared with advertisers. Our privacy policy sets out exactly what is sent and what is not.

GENERAL WELLNESS, NOT MEDICAL ADVICE
Readiness is a general wellness and fitness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and it is not a substitute for medical advice. It reads consumer fitness data from Apple Health and, optionally, from your Garmin account through Garmin's cloud Health API. It connects to no hardware and makes no medical claims. If you have a health concern, speak to a doctor.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://thereadiness.app/privacy/
